newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama police make major cocaine haul.
newsitem.headline: Panama police make major cocaine haul.

text.p: Panamanian police have seized nearly 600 pounds (270 kg) of cocaine worth $1 million hidden in a truckload of vegetables, the head of the police anti-narcotics unit said on Thursday.

The police arrested two Panamanians when they seized the drugs late Wednesday in the western province of Bocas del Toro in one of the country's largest drug hauls in recent months, Rosendo Miranda told reporters.
The arrests followed a routine traffic stop in the port city of Almirante.
Panama, a major transit point for drugs, seized more than eight tons of cocaine last year, 15 percent more than the previous year.
